QB.name: Baker Mayfield
QB.injury: Nov 17: The Buccaneers appear to be preparing for the possibility of Mayfield (foot) being sidelined for Sunday's game against the Lions, after the team signed Cooper Rush to the practice squad and signed Easton Stick to the 53-man roster Monday, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

QB.name: Jaxson Dart
QB.injury: Sep 30: Dart recently underwent surgery to repair the meniscus and MCL in his left knee, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

QB.name: Jalen Hurts
QB.injury: Oct 19: Hurts (calf) is expected to be held out of football activities for multiple months and miss the rest of the season after new imaging over the weekend revealed several blood clots in his lungs, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

QB.name: Drake Maye
QB.injury: Nov 16: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he didn't have a definitive diagnosis for the injury Maye (ankle) sustained in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, but indicated that the quarterback will miss time," Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports. "I wouldn't imagine him being available coming out of the [Week 11] bye," Vrabel said.

QB.name: Lamar Jackson
QB.injury: Nov 13: Jackson (thumb) is "doing well" and is expected to be out for "6-to-10 weeks," per head coach Jesse Minter.

QB.name: Malik Willis
QB.injury: Nov 16: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that Willis (groin/core) has not undergone surgery and that the Dolphins are still determining if a procedure is needed, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

QB.name: Sam Darnold
QB.injury: Nov 16: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

QB.name: Geno Smith
QB.injury: Nov 16: Smith underwent tests Monday that didn't reveal a major injury to his left ankle, and he'll continue to be evaluated during the week before the Jets decide on his status for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

RB.name: TreVeyon Henderson
RB.injury: Nov 14: Henderson (illness) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

RB.name: De'Von Achane
RB.injury: Sep 28: The Dolphins placed Achane (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

RB.name: RJ Harvey
RB.injury: Oct 31: The Broncos placed Harvey (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

RB.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
RB.injury: Nov 17: The Commanders designated Croskey-Merritt (groin) for return from injured reserve Tuesday.

RB.name: Jeremiyah Love
RB.injury: Nov 3: Arizona placed Love (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

RB.name: Tyler Goodson
RB.injury: Nov 14: The Cowboys placed Goodson (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.

RB.name: Brian Robinson
RB.injury: Nov 7: Robinson (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.

RB.name: Josh Jacobs
RB.injury: Nov 17: Jacobs (finger) has a "realistic chance" of returning to action Nov. 25 against the Rams following the Packers' Week 11 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

RB.name: Tyrone Tracy
RB.injury: Oct 27: The Giants placed Tracy (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

WR.name: Puka Nacua
WR.injury: Nov 15: Nacua (knee/toe) has an expected return date of "mid-December," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

WR.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
WR.injury: Nov 16: Harrison (hamstring) was estimated as a non-participant on Monday's practice report.

WR.name: Terry McLaurin
WR.injury: Oct 30: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

WR.name: Mike Evans
WR.injury: Nov 16: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that the 49ers are "hoping to" have Evans (Achilles) back at practice this week, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

WR.name: Alec Pierce
WR.injury: Nov 11: When asked Wednesday whether Pierce (heel) has a chance to return from IR this season, Colts head coach Shane Steichen was noncommittal, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

WR.name: Jaylen Waddle
WR.injury: Nov 8: Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

WR.name: Wandale Robinson
WR.injury: Nov 15: Robinson is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jaguars due to an ankle injury.

WR.name: AJ Brown
WR.injury: Nov 15: Brown (hamstring) was spotted walking around with a limp in the locker room following Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, Andrew Callahan of the Boston Herald reports.

WR.name: Jordan Addison
WR.injury: Nov 16: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Addison will require surgery on his thumb and will miss a few weeks, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

WR.name: Michael Pittman
WR.injury: Nov 16: Coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that the Steelers are "hopeful" they can get Pittman -- who last played in Week 4 -- back from his foot injury this week, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

WR.name: Davante Adams
WR.injury: Nov 15: According to Ian Rapoport of NFL Network and ESPN, Adams (hamstring) is believed to be targeting a return to action Nov. 25 against the Packers.

WR.name: Romeo Doubs
WR.injury: Oct 19: Doubs (shoulder) is hopeful to return after the Patriots' Week 11 bye and isn't expected to face a long-term absence, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

WR.name: Jayden Reed
WR.injury: Sep 30: The Packers are expected to place Reed (neck) on injured reserve Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

WR.name: Carnell Tate
WR.injury: Nov 16: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that he's hopeful that Tate (shoulder) will return to action in Week 11 versus the Cowboys, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

WR.name: Kendrick Bourne
WR.injury: Nov 3: Arizona placed Bourne (tibia) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

WR.name: Michael Wilson
WR.injury: Nov 10: The Cardinals placed Wilson (neck) on injured reserve Tuesday.

WR.name: Jalen Brooks
WR.injury: Oct 27: The Cardinals placed Brooks (wrist) on injured reserve Tuesday.

WR.name: Jaylin Noel
WR.injury: Oct 28: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

TE.name: TJ Hockenson
TE.injury: Nov 16: Coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that the Vikings expect Hockenson (wrist/chest) to make progress ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

TE.name: Brock Bowers
TE.injury: Nov 16: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak confirmed Monday that Bowers (ankle) is considered day-to-day after exiting Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports. "It's not as bad as we thought, but still a significant injury," Kubiak said.

TE.name: Cole Kmet
TE.injury: Oct 23: The Bears placed Kmet (knee) on injured reserve Friday.
